title: Lamp in the Lift
summary: On Day seven, Maya and Dev find out what turned on the elevator lamp.

beats.text: Day seven. The lamp stayed lit, and something inside the car breathed.
Dev slid the keycards into his fist. "Nobody moves. Nobody breathes."
beats.speaker: dev

beats.text: A hand gripped the doorframe. A small one, with a bandaged wrist.
A boy tumbled out, soaked, clutching Ruth's torch.
He drank three cups of water. He rode up from thirty.
"Ruth told me to follow the lights," he whispered. "She is not alone over there."
Across the gap, Calder Tower flashed two long, three short. Twenty-three.
He said his mother vanished on Day two.
"The skybridge is open," he said. "They want you to cross."
Ruth's voice broke through the static. "Maya, that boy died on Day two."
beats.speaker: ruth
